211032.overview:
Zector Adventure is a text adventure for the TRS-80 CoCo.

You have just been pulled into the enemy ship by a tractor beam. You must find the ship's battle plans and somehow return them to the rebel fleet. You started equipped with only your blaster.

All commands are via VERB NOUN entry. Available directions are shown on the screen at all times. There is no save/restore feature.

217180.overview:
The Zaxxon defense system must be destroyed in this isometric-viewed shoot 'em up. The game has three stages, first taking you through Asteroid City, which is heavily protected by aircraft, guns, and missiles. Many barriers are alarmed, leaving you with limited space to progress through, and fire must constantly be dodged.

Stage two is a space shoot out against hordes of enemy aircraft - those you failed to destroy in the first part of the task. Complete this and you reach the final battle with Zaxxon, the game looping with increased difficulty if you can survive the first time. There are three distinct skill levels, while controls involve using forward to dive and back to climb, in the manner of flight simulation.

446837.overview:
Looking into the vastness of space, you think about the galactic voyage ahead. You are a ZoneRunner, an interplanetary soldier of fortune, about to embark on your next mission. Your adventure entails flying your spacecraft among planets located in the outlying area of two closely situated galaxies. Your livelihood depends on buying and selling vitally-needed goods.

The player moves between planets buying and selling commodities to increase their wealth. To move between locations, the player selects the direction of movement and their engine power. Player location is shown on a galactic map with 3 levels of magnification. Upon arriving at different systems, the player can buy and sell commodities. Control of shields and weapons are also controlled by sliding bars, and these need to be replenished at systems.

446860.overview: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz is a text adventure, a sequel to the classic first Zork. Once again, the game is set in the Great Underground Empire, but this time the main goal is to face off against the titular Wizard.

446892.overview: Zork: I is a classic text adventure game. The player begins as an "adventurer" standing near a white house in a nice forest, but soon descends into the Great Underground Empire, where most of the game takes place. The player's quest is to collect the Nineteen Treasures of Zork.

446972.overview: In the third game of the adventure game series Zork, you are once again a nameless adventurer, only this time you won't travel through a beautiful magical land, but are immediately cast into a deep dungeon. Like in a dream, you hear a mysterious voice telling you that you have passed all the tests but one. When consciousness returns to you, you find yourself on the endless spiral of stairs, with only your trusty lantern near you... will you be able to survive the horrors of the Dungeon?

464925.overview:
You are on a mission through the radioactive rubble of The Aftermath. Safety lies beyond the enemy in Zone 6. In the cockpit of the strike force Zyton-class tank, your hands clench the controls. Your plasma shield disintegrates all in your path - as long as it lasts! 

Zone 6 brings you to the hi-tech battleground with totally computerized controls - advanced 3-D telemetry, scanners, digital mapping, detectors, and range finders. A pulser cannon can vaporize any object. You must navigate five zones of structures, destroying fuel dumps, jammers, super jammers, homing blockades, and force-sinks. 

The structures flash onto your scanner, moving toward you in 3-D. Every placement is precisely positioned on your digitizer. Detectors blink with the presence of jammers and supper jammers which block location of fuel dumps. They must be found with your scanner and destroyed. A range finder helps you evade or destroy the homing blockades and force-sinks - enemy traps to sap shield strength. 

Home your skills well. To get to Zone 6 you must master to hi-tech battle ground!

464929.overview: Fly your spaceship through enemy Starbases. Avoid guides missiles, lasers, and firing turrets! Can you reach their leader ... ZAKSUND?

465088.overview: Zeus is an original arcade game, where you a wizard battling Zeus (the god), armed with a "Cone of Cold". The first 4 rounds, you have to shoot lightning bolts that come at you; starting on wave 5, there are clouds added (and they later start moving) that you can't stay under for too long. You have a power indicator, and the more often you fire, the more this gets used up (and the shorter range your blasts have), so you can't just fire constantly. You also have a shield, but that doesn't last forever, either.
